description: Runs the analysis pipelines over some content. Nothing is stored: creating one returns what the pipelines found, in result.  The content itself is not an attribute. It is sent beside this object, as the second part of a multipart body whose first part is this object, so that a payload of any size is streamed rather than held in memory at every hop. See the analyze handler.

analyzers.description: The analyzers to run. An empty list runs the ones enabled by default, and a name prefixed with '-' turns one off, '+' turns one on, '@' just run that one.
analyzers.title: analyzers

annotations.description: Annotations carried alongside the content, like the conversation ID. They are set during extraction, passed to the analysis and kept on what it produces.
annotations.title: annotations

coverage.description: How much of the content to look at. Auto lets the pipelines decide from its size.
coverage.title: coverage

customDataTypes.description: The custom data types to detect, on top of the built-in ones.
customDataTypes.title: customDataTypes

index.description: Which message this is in a multi-turn payload. Analyses run in parallel, so this is what puts the history back in order. Always sent: index 0 is a position, and an absent one means the order is unknown.
index.title: index

kind.description: The kind of content carried by this extraction. Used together with role to label what the extracted blob represents so the UI can render it correctly and analyzers can dispatch appropriately: - Message: free-form natural language (default). - Thinking: model reasoning trace (e.g. Anthropic thinking, OpenAI reasoning, Gemini thought). - ToolDefinition: tool/function schema advertised to the model (name, description, JSON schema). - ToolInput: structured arguments the model passes when invoking a tool. - ToolOutput: result returned to the model after a tool call. - File: uploaded or attached file payload. - Resource: externally-supplied context injected into the prompt (RAG document, search result, MCP resource). - Event: control or lifecycle marker with no analyzable content.
kind.title: kind

principalKey.description: Identifies who the content belongs to, without naming them.
principalKey.title: principalKey

processing.description: Inband when someone is waiting on the answer, Offband when nobody is. Offband rides a longer retry curve.
processing.title: processing

profile.description: DEPRECATED The analysis profile to run with. The pipelines no longer use it.
profile.title: profile

role.description: The role of the message represented by this extraction.
role.title: role

sessionID.description: Ties the analyses of one conversation together.
sessionID.title: sessionID

toolFilters.description: Which tools the analysis should be restricted to.
toolFilters.title: toolFilters

toolResults.description: Tool call results which are passed in to this request.
toolResults.title: toolResults

toolUses.description: Tool uses as requested by a model.
toolUses.title: toolUses

title: Analysis
